title: Implement Request Logging Middleware
description: This feature adds a logging middleware to track and record all incoming requests, providing valuable insights for debugging and performance optimization. It will log request metadata such as method, path, and response status. This will improve the overall debugging experience and help identify potential issues
testCases: Test logging for different HTTP methods
acceptance: The logging middleware should log all incoming requests with their corresponding metadata, and the logs should be easily accessible for debugging purposes
reason: Improves debugging capabilities and provides valuable insights for performance optimization
